newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian presidential motorcade leaves hospital.
newsitem.headline: Russian presidential motorcade leaves hospital.

text.p: The presidential motorcade left the Central Clinical Hospital on Monday where Boris Yeltsin has been having treatment for pneumonia, but the Kremlin did not confirm the president was inside.
Reporters saw a fleet of black cars with an escort of jeeps drive down the snowy driveway of the hospital and out of the gate shortly after the Kremlin said the president would be discharged.

"The in-patient stage of Boris Nikolayevich's treatment for double pneumonia is finishing today and the president is transferring to the Gorky-9 residence near Moscow where his treatment will continue," presidential press secretary Sergei Yastrzhembsky told a news briefing.
Yeltsin, 65, was taken to the hospital on January 8 suffering from pneumonia, two weeks after returing to his Kremlin office following heart surgery on November 5.
